author: marioalsalinas
quote:
This game was the reason I bought the PS5. I pre-ordered it a couple of months ago, and it let me down by the second day. I've been a fan of the series since GTA 2. I like it because it gives you a sense of freedom, but that's not the case here. The missions are long and boring, like dancing, going to pick up flowers, or playing video games with your fat friend before arranging the living room. I didn't like it. The female character is a tattooed fat Latina who's just annoying. 
It's terrible watching Jason work without enjoying his life, struggling to please a bossy woman who doesn't respect him.
